RE: OFFER OF EMPLOYMENT – PADMA KUMARI

Dear Padma,

On behalf of Tech Solutions Inc. (the "Company" or "Petitioner"), I am pleased to formally offer you the position detailed below. We recognize your extraordinary ability in the field of enterprise cloud architecture, and we are eager to have you join our team to lead our most critical engineering initiatives.

This offer is structured to comply with U.S. immigration regulations for non-immigrant employment classifications. Please review the terms and conditions of your employment below.

\begin{itemize}

\item Architecting and leading the technical roadmap for the "DataSync Pro" enterprise integration platform.

\item Designing and implementing the proprietary "Zero-Trust Microservices Framework" to reduce cross-border data synchronization latency.

\item Directing, managing, and technically overseeing the core engineering "Tiger Team" of 25 senior software engineers.

\item Leading internal R\&D initiatives in AI-driven cloud orchestration and real-time resource optimization.

\end{itemize}

[TN – COMPUTER SYSTEMS ANALYST] TN-Specific Duties (mapped to the USMCA/NAFTA Professional occupation "Computer Systems Analyst"):

\begin{itemize}

\item At-Will Employment: Your employment with Tech Solutions Inc. is "at-will." This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without notice.

\item Prevailing Wage Compliance: The Company guarantees that your compensation will at all times meet or exceed the prevailing wage for the occupational classification in the area of intended employment, as required by the U.S. Department of Labor.

\item Contingencies: This offer of employment is strictly contingent upon your successful passing of a background check and the approval of your corresponding non-immigrant visa petition by U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS).

\end{itemize}

ACCEPTANCE AND NEXT STEPS

If you choose to accept this offer, please sign and date this letter where indicated below and return a scanned copy to our Human Resources department. Upon acceptance, our immigration legal counsel will immediately initiate the filing of your petition with USCIS.

We are incredibly excited about the prospect of you joining Tech Solutions Inc. and look forward to the transformative impact your extraordinary abilities will have on our organization.

Sincerely,

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_                  Date: July 15, 2026

Michael Chen

Chief Executive Officer \& Co-Founder

Tech Solutions Inc.

ACCEPTED AND AGREED:

I, Padma Kumari, have read and understand the terms and conditions of this offer of employment. I accept the position of Senior Software Engineer / Lead Principal Cloud Architect under the terms outlined above.
